messages:
Evelyn C: Morning team — finishing up my laptop but stuck on a few onboarding bits. Okta passkey enrollment fails with 'invalid credential' on Firefox/Ubuntu 22.04. 1Password invite not in my inbox, and Shared drives in Drive is empty. Who do I ping for SSO/MFA + Drive access?
Drew (People Ops): hi Evelyn, welcome! tagging IT. @Samir (IT) can you take a look? also confirm which email you used for the invites. :wave:
Evelyn C: used evelyn.c@redwood.ai. i can access Slack and GitHub SSO worked earlier, oddly.
Samir (IT): hey @Evelyn C — Linux WebAuthn on Firefox sometimes needs udev rules for FIDO devices or the browser needs to be started without sandbox in some distro setups. quick checks: 1) do you have a hardware key (YubiKey) or are you using a platform authenticator? 2) can you try Chrome/Chromium and retry the enroll flow?
Evelyn C: using a YubiKey 5 NFC on USB-C. i'll try Chromium now.
Samir (IT): also run `lsusb | grep -i yubico` and paste output if Chromium shows errors. if nothing shows, we may need to reload udev rules: `sudo udevadm control --reload-rules && sudo udevadm trigger`
Evelyn C: `lsusb` shows `Bus 001 Device 007: ID 1050:0407 Yubico.com`
Samir (IT): good — device visible. try Chromium enroll.
Evelyn C: Chromium flow prompted for touch and then failed with 'Invalid signature'.
Samir (IT): ok that indicates a mismatch between the RP ID Okta expects and what the browser is sending; sometimes our corp proxy strips a header. two paths: A) quick workaround: enable temporary SMS fallback so we can finish 1Password + Drive provisioning, B) escalate to infra to whitelabel proxy for the enroll endpoint. Which do you prefer?
Evelyn C: i'd rather not enable SMS if avoidable. can infra check the proxy?
Samir (IT): sure. i'm kicking infra and will push the minimal fix. in the meantime i'll manually add you to the Google group so Drive shows up and re-send the 1Password invite.
IT-Bot: infra ticket created: INFRA-1951234567 - proxy header affecting WebAuthn RP ID.
Dev-Bot: 1Password invite queued to evelyn.c@redwood.ai (automated).
Samir (IT): done — i pushed a manual sync to GSuite and re-sent the 1Password invite. please log out of Google and back in, then check Shared drives.
Evelyn C: 1Password invite arrived, can sign in via SSO. Drive now shows 'Redwood > Eng' and i can open onboarding folder. thanks.
Samir (IT): infra applied a header passthrough rule and retried the OKTA enroll logs show success when you try again. try the enroll in Chromium now.
Evelyn C: tried and success! passkey enrolled and Okta shows device. :tada:
Drew (People Ops): welcome again! i'll add you to the buddy rotation.
Samir (IT): leaving a short playbook in #it-setup: Linux + YubiKey notes: prefer Chromium, ensure udev rules present, reload rules if device not visible, escalate to INFRA if RP ID mismatch. If in doubt, ping IT for a quick screenshare.
Evelyn C: super helpful, thank you all.
